title: Northwest River Park Campground

services.name: Cabins
services.desc: See our Campground Guide (PDF) for more information, campground map, regulations and more. We have 72 sites for family camping and six group sites for organizations. Facilities include hot showers, laundry, recreation vehicle (RV) pump out, and fresh water. Maximum 6 people per site. Sites are limited to 14-night stays in a 30-day period. Reservations for campsites start January 1 for the following camping season (normally April 1 to November 30). Enjoy a luxurious weekend of climate-controlled camping comfort. Two cabins are available for rent, by week or weekend. The cabins come complete with sink, microwave oven, refrigerator, rustic log furniture, queen-size bed, full-size sleeper futon

services.name: Other Rentals
